name: SportRack 4 Bike Hitch Rack
description_full: This hitch rack holds 4 bikes and is super sturdy. It has a 2 inch receiver for your vehicle. Max weight 180lbs.

name: Evenflo Pivot Xplore Stroller Wagon
description: Converts between stroller and wagon, fits 2 kids.
description_full: Evenflo Pivot Xplore All-Terrain Stroller Wagon — flips between push (stroller) and pull (wagon) mode with a three-position telescoping handle. Fits up to 2 children from 6 months to 5 years (55 lb per seat, 110 lb total). Features all-terrain wheels for pavement, sand, and trails, a UPF 50+ canopy, 3-point safety harnesses, flip-flop-friendly brakes, and a compact fold for storage.

name: Yardworks 20V Cordless Patio Cleaner
description: Cordless patio cleaner kit with battery and charger for outdoor cleaning.
description_full: Yardworks 20V cordless patio cleaner, powered by an included 4.0Ah battery and charger. Designed to scrub dirt, grime, and moss off patios, decks, and walkways without a hose. Lightweight and cordless for easy maneuvering around outdoor surfaces, offering quick, convenient cleaning without needing an electrical outlet nearby.

name: Evenflo 4-in-1 Eat & Grow High Chair
description: Convertible high chair that grows with your child through four feeding and play stages.
description_full: Converts from infant high chair to toddler dining chair with tray, standalone toddler chair, and big kid table and chair. For children 6 months up to 50 lbs. Includes 5-point safety harness, removable tray, and machine-washable seat pad for easy cleaning.

name: Mastercraft 69-pc Screwdriver Set
description: 69-piece screwdriver set with wall-mountable storage stand.
description_full: Includes 8 precision drivers, 6 nut drivers, 16 hex keys, 20 screwdriver bits, a multi-bit driver, a 3" awl, and a 3" hook, all organized in a wall-mountable stand. Contoured triangular handles give an ergonomic grip, chrome-vanadium steel blades add durability, and stamped size markings make identification quick.

name: Mastercraft 8-Outlet Power Bar
description: 8-outlet power bar with 6-ft cord and circuit breaker.
description_full: Features 5 regular and 3 widely spaced outlets for large adapter plugs, a lighted on/off switch with a built-in circuit breaker, and durable steel housing. Includes a wall-mount wrap and a 6-foot grounded cord for extended reach in the shop or garage.

name: Everlast Core Freestanding Heavy Bag
description: Freestanding heavy bag with adjustable height and water/sand base.
description_full: Freestanding heavy bag with an air-foam chamber for realistic impact, power transfer rings to reduce base movement, and a rounded design for easy movement. Adjustable height 57"-65". High-density base holds up to 250 lbs of water or 370 lbs of sand for stability. Not recommended for outdoor use.

name: WorkPro 6-Piece Pliers Set
description: 6-piece pliers set with non-slip TPR handles.
description_full: Six-piece pliers set including 6-inch long nose, diagonal, and slip joint pliers, an 8-inch groove joint plier, and mini long nose and diagonal pliers. Features durable heat-treated steel construction, corrosion resistance, and non-slip yellow and black TPR handles. Suitable for electrical, contractor, and DIY use.

name: Black+Decker 10-Speed Countertop Blender
description: 550W countertop blender with 10 speeds and pulse control.
description_full: A 550-watt countertop blender with 10 speed settings plus pulse control for ice-crushing power. Features a removable 4-point stainless steel blade and a 5-cup glass jar. All removable parts are dishwasher-safe for easy cleanup. Handles smoothies, frozen drinks, soups, and purees.

name: Mastercraft Freestanding Vertical Bike Rack
description: Freestanding vertical rack that stores one bike upright
description_full: A freestanding vertical bike rack that holds one bike upright to save floor space in a garage, apartment, or storage area. No wall mounting or drilling needed — just stand it in place. Sturdy steel construction with a black finish, built to hold a single bike securely.
